payload.notice: The linked-event metric rollups (significance, goldstein_scale, goldstein_severity, magnitude, systemic_importance, propagation_potential, market_sensitivity, confidence) were removed from /api/v2/stories/summary on 2026-08-18: they are properties of a Story's linked Events, not of the Story, and their averages were computed over all stories including those with no events, understating them by up to 84%. Use /api/v2/events/summary for event metrics — its numbers are computed per event, so they will not match the values this endpoint previously returned.

coverage.note: First day of continuous story clustering. Clusters are dated by observation, so this is the true minimum.

payload.counting_basis: story_count is a DE-DUPLICATED count: Stories sharing a linked Event, or a normalized label on the same day, are counted once. It is also WINDOW-DEPENDENT — a given day's bucket can be lower inside a wide window than when that day is queried alone, because the linked-Event de-dup key is not date-scoped. Compare like for like: query the same window you are reconciling against. GET /api/v2/stories also folds independently adjudicated duplicate Stories into a stable canonical representative and reports each page's fold as pagination.duplicates_collapsed.
